props.gloss_en: in truth they said: the attendant sees where the children are reading
but he himself may not read
no -- [he 'sees'] to arrange the beginnings of his sections
Rabba bar Shmuel: but he arranges the beginnings of his sections
[Rabba bar Shmuel, continuing:] and the whole section -- no
RSbG: the schoolchildren would arrange sections and read by the light of the lamp
if you wish, say: [RSbG speaks of] the beginnings of the sections
and if you wish, say: children are different -- since the fear of their teacher is on them, they will not come to tilt [the lamp]
